Approved: the text after /kit-build in my message
First run `python tools/pbik/pbik.py project check`. On exit 5 stop: Desktop is newer than targetDesktop in design/specs/project.json, so tell me to run /update first. On exit 3 (version not found) ask me for the version from Help > About and rerun with `--version <version>`. A warning that Desktop is older than the target is fine: note it and go on.
Build the entire report on disk with Desktop closed. Native first.
Read design/checks.md, .claude/rules/pbik.md, .claude/rules/svg.md, docs/lessons/build.md, the lessons for the visual types on the page (docs/lessons/cards.md, slicers.md, charts.md), docs/lessons/accessibility.md and the done-when lines in design/specs/spec.md before building.
Build with pbik from layout.json alone (tools/pbik/README.md lists every key): put everything in design/specs/layout.json (theme, the page that opens first, bindings, sort, filters, reference lines, actions, container, text, conditional formatting, navigator states, props), with styling from design/tokens.json, so a layout change means editing layout.json and re-running the build. Run `python design/scripts/gen_theme.py`, then `pbik build <Report> design/specs/layout.json`. Extension measures for SVG go through `pbik measure ext add`.
Don't write build code (no design/scripts/build.py, no patch scripts, no hand edits of visual.json). If something can't be expressed in layout.json, even with `props` and `{"raw": ...}` copied from a Desktop-saved file (design/templates, the Patterns page, `pbik catalog show`), stop and report it as a pbik gap: the visual ID, the setting, the Desktop-saved JSON if there is one, and add it to design/known-gaps.md.
Build the first card (or any repeated unit) first and check it before repeating it (docs/lessons/build.md). Build each visual with the method layout.json records for its ID. If design/scripts/audit_layout.py doesn't match this project's design/specs/layout.json, update it to read the boxes and styles from layout.json instead of a hardcoded list. Don't skip the audit.
Decide small things yourself, note them in the spec by visual ID, and log fallbacks in the fallback register. If an untested native option fails, use the simplest native alternative and log it; don't stop.
Stop only if: a model change beyond the approved list is needed, a new fallback is needed, a pbik gap blocks a visual, a file would be deleted, or validation fails twice.
Run `pbik build` twice and confirm the second run prints "No changes". Validate with `pbik validate <Report> --layout design/specs/layout.json` (not the pbip-validator agent), then design/scripts/audit_layout.py and design/scripts/audit_ids.py, and audit_svg.py if there are SVG measures. Fix real errors, commit, then give me the numbered Desktop click list and ask me to reopen Desktop once. If `pbik desktop state` exits 3 (no Desktop Bridge), the click list starts with the manual reload steps in .claude/rules/pbik.md ("When the Desktop Bridge is missing").
